name: Al Azif
source:
The partner of [url=https://vndb.org/c96259]Kurou[/url]. Her true nature is the embodiment of the most powerful Grimoire [Al Azif]. Despite the sweet appearance her pesonality is that of arrogant and prideful. This time again, she confront the Others along with [url=https://vndb.org/c96259]Kurou[/url]. She has the power to transform [url=https://vndb.org/c96259]Kurou[/url] into [Magius Style] that possessed superhuman abilities.

"Don't play games with me. I know things about you like the back of my hand."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.demonbane.com/special/]Demonbane Official Site[/url]]
